agent_tank_intent: Protect buyers from post-agreement AI-agent service substitution by keeping the original accepted manifest immutable, deterministically flagging critical changes, and using GenLayer consensus only for prose-level material equivalence.
security_properties: critical structured changes are deterministic material/no-model
semantic comparison always uses original baseline, not active/intermediate service
material substitution freezes handoff until buyer action
unreported changed declared manifest cannot finalize
provider cannot replace pending material proposal
bounded semantic consensus budget with buyer-only grants
provider can withdraw a pending material proposal only by retreating to the already-authorized active manifest
withdrawn candidate is permanently blocked and cannot reroll
withdrawal preserves prior buyer-rejected ledger entries; throwaway withdrawal cannot launder an earlier rejection
honest_scope: party-declared manifests are not publisher provenance
contract does not verify external-world delivery truth
distinct addresses are contract-local roles, not proof of independent real-world control
equivalent prose substitutions auto-activate by design and have no buyer-side reversal once active
semantic-call bound applies to committed consensus rounds; fully reverted rounds leave no persistent counter/ledger entry
service_name is intentionally semantic rather than a deterministic critical field
